user.title: Add a TRO.Y 2 shade
user.description: Connect directly to one Screen Innovations shade through TRO.Y 2.

data_description.host: Enter only the IP address or hostname, without http://.
data_description.node_id: Enter the wired shade node ID reported by your TRO.Y controller.
data_description.shade_name: The name shown in Home Assistant and Apple Home.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the shade position from TRO.Y 2. Check the IP address and node ID.

abort.already_configured: This TRO.Y 2 shade is already configured.

set_wired_speeds.name: Set wired shade speeds
set_wired_speeds.description: Set the persistent up, down, and slow rolling speeds for an RS485 shade.

up_speed.name: Up speed
up_speed.description: Rolling speed used while opening the shade.

down_speed.name: Down speed
down_speed.description: Rolling speed used while closing the shade.

slow_speed.name: Slow speed
slow_speed.description: Rolling speed used by the motor's slow movement mode.
